correctness.rationale: The explicit mean solves the finite-state first-step recursion, and the explicit quartic variance solves the exact law-of-total-variance recursion with correct absorbing and boundary cases. A uniform reset word ensures finite moments and uniqueness. Polynomial residuals vanish identically; separately constructed rational Markov systems verify all initial pairs at n=3..8. The asymptotic coefficient follows from the leading terms at the unique worst-mean pair.

originality.rationale: Gusev (2014), Section 3, Theorems 3-4 and equations (14)-(20), gives first-moment results for this exact model, but not a second-moment equation solved for every initial pair, nor the quartic variance or nonzero limiting relative deviation. The complete article on shortest reset words concerns a distinct random variable. Semantically targeted searches of mathematical records and accessible own claims find no stronger covering statement. Residual risk of an unindexed or alternate-form variance theorem remains.

value.rationale: An exact all-size variance profile and the nonvanishing asymptotic relative standard deviation quantify uncertainty in recovery under random inputs for a classical hard-to-reset automaton. The fluctuation invariant is naturally motivated and not contained in a deterministic length or mean-only result; this is neither a routine parameter change nor a finite table.
